notes: s010/s011: the ASV writes both a supplied verb *he had* and a supplied *while he was*. The relative clause went to the article, whose modifier is verbless (rule 31's carve-out), and the subordinator and copula to the preposition; putting *he had* on the preposition as well and leaving the article only *which*, per rule 31's *only which* for a following article, remains defensible.
s022 δι' carries the whole concessive expansion *though they be in* under rule 62, the preposition being the token whose phrase the ASV recast; head on the prepositional word.
s017 αὐτόν is expressed, so rule 74's supplied-subject clause does not apply and the accusative takes *he* as its own unit.
